package.name: tactile_processing
package.description:
Bridges tactile_core's hardware/ROS-free processing math (Step 1) into the ROS2 graph: subscribes to debiased tactile data and publishes tactile_msgs/TactileProcessed (centroid + geometric zone). The limit_surface_point field is intentionally NOT populated yet -- it needs a wrench estimate that does not exist until Step 12 (ANN inference / combine_wrench).
Note: `tactile_core` itself is NOT listed as a <depend> here. It is a plain pip package (see src/tactile_core/COLCON_IGNORE), installed editable into the container's system Python by docker/entrypoint.sh, so it is importable without any ROS-level dependency declaration.
